conflictZones.name: Iran War Theater
conflictZones.description: Joint US-Israeli military operation (US: Operation Epic Fury / Israel: Operation Roaring Lion). 1000+ targets struck including military, nuclear, and leadership sites. Supreme Leader Khamenei killed in Tehran strikes. Iran retaliating with missiles and drones across the region.

conflictZones.name: Strait of Hormuz Crisis
conflictZones.description: Iran attempting to close Strait of Hormuz. IRGC naval/air operations active. Three tankers damaged. US sank 9 Iranian warships. GPS spoofing/jamming reported. 20-30% of global oil/gas transits through this chokepoint. Brent crude spiking to $80+.

conflictZones.name: Ukraine War
conflictZones.description: Full-scale Russian invasion of Ukraine. Active frontlines in Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kherson oblasts. Heavy artillery, drone warfare, and trench combat.

conflictZones.name: Gaza Conflict
conflictZones.description: Israeli military operations in Gaza following October 7 attacks. Ground invasion, aerial bombardment. Humanitarian crisis. Regional escalation with Hezbollah.

conflictZones.name: Israel-Lebanon Border
conflictZones.description: Cross-border artillery and rocket fire. Targeted assassinations. High risk of full-scale escalation.

conflictZones.name: Red Sea Crisis
conflictZones.description: Houthi maritime campaign against commercial shipping. US/UK airstrikes on Houthi targets. Ongoing blockade attempts.

conflictZones.name: Sudan Civil War
conflictZones.description: Power struggle between SAF and RSF paramilitary has engulfed the entire country. RSF controls most of Darfur and Khartoum; SAF holds Port Sudan and eastern regions. World's largest displacement crisis. Famine conditions in multiple states.

conflictZones.name: Myanmar Civil War
conflictZones.description: Civil war following 2021 military coup. Resistance forces and ethnic armed organizations have captured significant territory. Junta losing control of border regions. Multiple coordinated offensives ongoing.

conflictZones.name: Korean Demilitarized Zone
conflictZones.description: 250km-long, 4km-wide buffer zone along the Military Demarcation Line established by the 1953 Korean Armistice Agreement. Despite its name, one of the most heavily militarized borders in the world.

conflictZones.name: Pakistan–Afghanistan Border Conflict
conflictZones.description: Escalating tensions along the Pakistan–Afghanistan border. Pakistan has conducted cross-border strikes targeting TTP sanctuaries in Afghan territory, prompting border closures and diplomatic friction with the Taliban government. Long-running dispute over militant safe havens and border security.

miningSites.significance: Only active US lithium mine. Nevada brine operation since 1966.

miningSites.name: Thacker Pass
miningSites.significance: Largest known lithium deposit in the US. Under development in Nevada.

miningSites.name: Manono
miningSites.significance: World's largest hard-rock lithium deposit. DRC asset under development.

miningSites.name: Mutanda
miningSites.significance: World's largest cobalt mine. ~25kt Co/yr when at full capacity.

miningSites.name: Tenke Fungurume
miningSites.significance: Major cobalt-copper producer. Chinese-owned. ~17kt Co/yr.

miningSites.name: Kamoto (KOV)
miningSites.significance: Major DRC cobalt-copper underground mine.

miningSites.name: Bayan Obo
miningSites.significance: World's largest rare earth mine. ~45% of global REE production from this single site.

miningSites.name: Mountain Pass
miningSites.significance: Only significant rare earth mine and processor in the US. Strategic national asset.

miningSites.name: Mount Weld
miningSites.significance: Highest-grade rare earth deposit outside China. Key non-Chinese REE source.

miningSites.name: Southern China REE
miningSites.significance: Jiangxi/Guangdong ion-adsorption clay deposits. Key source of heavy rare earths (dysprosium, terbium) critical for EV motors.

miningSites.name: Kvanefjeld
miningSites.significance: World-class REE + uranium deposit in Greenland. Subject to Greenland political debate.

miningSites.name: Weda Bay / Halmahera
miningSites.significance: Largest nickel pig iron (NPI) production hub. Core of Indonesia's nickel dominance.

miningSites.name: Morowali Industrial Park
miningSites.significance: Largest integrated nickel production hub globally. Drives ~50% of world's battery-grade nickel.

miningSites.name: Norilsk Complex
miningSites.significance: World's largest palladium mine and top nickel producer. Arctic Siberian site.

miningSites.name: Voisey's Bay
miningSites.significance: High-grade nickel-cobalt-copper mine in Labrador. Strategic Canadian deposit.

miningSites.name: Goro (Vale Nouvelle-Calédonie)
miningSites.significance: Major laterite nickel operation. Battery-grade nickel and cobalt production.

miningSites.name: Taganito
miningSites.significance: Key Philippine nickel laterite mine. Major Japanese nickel supply source.

miningSites.name: Mogalakwena
miningSites.significance: World's largest open-pit platinum mine. Bushveld Igneous Complex.

miningSites.name: Marikana / Rustenburg
miningSites.significance: Major Bushveld Complex platinum operations. Historically significant labor site.

miningSites.name: Zimplats
miningSites.significance: Zimbabwe's largest mining company. World's third-largest PGM producer.

miningSites.name: Stillwater
miningSites.significance: Only significant PGM mine in North America. Primary US palladium source.

miningSites.name: Pilbara Iron Ore (BHP)
miningSites.significance: BHP's Pilbara hub — world's most productive iron ore mining region. ~280Mt/yr.

miningSites.name: Pilbara Iron Ore (Rio Tinto)
miningSites.significance: Rio Tinto's Pilbara operations — 16 mines feeding 4 port facilities. ~330Mt/yr.

miningSites.name: Carajás
miningSites.significance: World's largest iron ore mine by proven reserves. Highest grade iron ore (~67% Fe).

miningSites.name: Sishen
miningSites.significance: Africa's largest iron ore mine. Major export source for European and Asian steel mills.

miningSites.name: Kiruna
miningSites.significance: Europe's largest iron ore mine. Undergoing city relocation due to mine expansion.

miningSites.name: McArthur River
miningSites.significance: World's highest-grade uranium mine. 25x average uranium ore grade. Saskatchewan, Canada.

miningSites.name: Cigar Lake
miningSites.significance: World's largest high-grade uranium deposit currently in production.

miningSites.name: Kazakhstan ISL Fields
miningSites.significance: Cluster of in-situ leaching uranium operations. Kazakhstan produces ~40% of world supply.

miningSites.name: Olympic Dam
miningSites.significance: World's largest known uranium ore body. Also produces copper, gold, silver.

miningSites.name: Rössing
miningSites.significance: One of the world's largest open-pit uranium mines. Chinese-owned since 2019.

miningSites.name: Husab
miningSites.significance: Second-largest uranium mine globally by production. 100% Chinese-owned.

processingPlants.name: Baotou REE Processing Complex
processingPlants.significance: World's largest rare earth processing hub. Processes ore from Bayan Obo.

processingPlants.name: Lynas Advanced Materials Plant (LAMP)
processingPlants.significance: Largest rare earth processing facility outside China. Processes Mt Weld ore.

processingPlants.name: Mountain Pass Processing
processingPlants.significance: US rare earth concentrate processing. Building downstream magnet manufacturing.

processingPlants.name: Ganzhou Lithium Hub
processingPlants.significance: China's major lithium chemical refining hub. Processes spodumene into battery-grade lithium.

processingPlants.name: Kwinana Lithium Refinery
processingPlants.significance: First lithium hydroxide refinery in Australia. Processes Greenbushes concentrate.

processingPlants.name: Chagres Copper Smelter
processingPlants.significance: Major Chilean copper smelter. Part of integrated Andean copper production chain.

processingPlants.name: Nkana Copper Smelter
processingPlants.significance: Key Zambian copper smelter and refinery on the Copperbelt.

processingPlants.name: Aurubis Hamburg
processingPlants.significance: Europe's largest copper smelter. Major recycled copper processor.

processingPlants.name: Rand Refinery
processingPlants.significance: World's largest gold refinery by cumulative output. Processes most of SA gold production.

processingPlants.name: PAMP Refinery
processingPlants.significance: Switzerland's leading precious metals refinery. Produces LBMA-accredited gold bars.

processingPlants.name: Norilsk Nickel Smelter
processingPlants.significance: World's largest nickel and palladium smelter. Also major SO2 emitter (Arctic pollution concern).

commodityPorts.name: Port Hedland
commodityPorts.significance: World's largest bulk export port. Handles ~18% of global seaborne iron ore trade.

commodityPorts.name: Dampier (Rio Tinto)
commodityPorts.significance: Rio Tinto's primary iron ore export terminal. Part of Pilbara port network.

commodityPorts.name: Coloso Port / Antofagasta
commodityPorts.significance: Chile's primary copper export port. Gateway for Escondida and northern Atacama mines.

commodityPorts.name: Port of Santos
commodityPorts.significance: Brazil's largest port. Key iron ore and agricultural export terminal.

commodityPorts.name: Richards Bay Coal Terminal
commodityPorts.significance: Africa's largest dry bulk export terminal. Primary South African coal export point.

commodityPorts.name: Port of Mombasa
commodityPorts.significance: Primary export gateway for DRC and Zambia cobalt and copper.

commodityPorts.name: Walvis Bay
commodityPorts.significance: Primary export port for Namibian uranium from Rössing and Husab mines.

commodityPorts.name: Tema Port
commodityPorts.significance: Primary gold export gateway for Ghana, one of Africa's largest gold producers.

commodityPorts.name: Port of Callao
commodityPorts.significance: Peru's main port. Primary export point for Andean copper, zinc, and silver production.

commodityPorts.name: Port of Tianjin
commodityPorts.significance: China's largest commodity import port. Primary iron ore, copper concentrate, and LME metals gateway.

commodityPorts.name: LME Antwerp Warehouse Hub
commodityPorts.significance: Major LME-licensed metals warehouse network in Europe. Zinc and copper storage hub.

criticalMinerals.name: Bayan Obo
criticalMinerals.significance: World largest REE mine (45% global production)
